Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Stock Manager
Punchline: Balances Island Sanctuary stock with imported Visland routes.
Description: Check the Island resources you want, set their stock levels, and let Stock Manager choose the best imported Visland routes automatically. Uses vnavmesh from your current position, supports roulette or a selected unlocked mount, detects flight and tool access, and includes Lifestream travel, surplus export, run statistics, and /sm commands.
Changelog: Fixed Visland route serialization and direct vnavmesh startup. Added a Settings tab with mount roulette or a specific unlocked mount, plus closest-waypoint starts when already near a route.
